source_excerpts.text:
\section{Recognizing and manufacturing the chain}
Group all identical nonzero-target phase carriers $F_i$ by their canonical
actual binary row spaces. Add $0$ and $R$ as endpoints. For every pair test
both actual inclusions. Accept precisely when each distinct carrier is
incomparable with at most one other carrier. Repeated factors at one carrier
do not create extra vertices. This is a check on the acquired arrangement,
not an input decomposition or an assumed constant number of crossings.

\begin{lemma}[Ordered crossing pairs]\label{lem:chain}
Under this condition, the singleton carriers and incomparable pairs form
an ordered sequence. For every incomparable pair $F,G$, manufacture
$I=F\cap G$ and $T=F+G$. The unmatched carriers together with all such
intersections and sums form a chain. The endpoints $I,T$ of each pair are
adjacent in that chain.
\end{lemma}
\begin{proof}
A third represented carrier $H$ must be comparable with both $F$ and $G$.
If its comparison directions differed, transitivity would make $F,G$
comparable. Hence either $H\subseteq F\cap G$ or $H\supseteq F+G$.
Apply the same observation to a second incomparable pair. Its members
cannot be on opposite sides of the first pair, since they would then be
comparable. Therefore entire pairs are ordered. Inserting the intersection
and sum of each pair preserves this order. No other carrier or pair endpoint
can lie strictly between those two inserted endpoints. Binary intersections
and sums are right $S$-submodules because the original spaces are.
\end{proof}
The implementation also verifies every consecutive spine inclusion and
every claimed endpoint adjacency. These are polynomial checks and retain
explicit rejection diagnostics.

\section{The crossing-pair transfer}
All dimensions in this section are natural dimensions over $\F_q$; Morita
equivalence identifies the actual right $S$-submodule lattice with this
finite-vector-space lattice for the proof. No such coordinate identification
is computed by the algorithm.

Fix an incomparable pair $F,G$, set $I=F\cap G$, $T=F+G$, and write
\[
 i=\dim I,\quad A=\dim F-i,\quad B=\dim G-i,
 \quad\dim T=i+A+B.
\]
Suppose the current intersection $E=J\cap I$ is a fixed $e$-subspace. For
$J_T=J\cap T$ let
\[
 t=\dim J_T,\quad
 \alpha=\dim(J_T\cap F)-e,\quad
 \beta=\dim(J_T\cap G)-e,\quad
 u=t-e-\alpha-\beta.
\]
Use Gaussian coefficients equal to zero outside

## E. Failures, comparisons and evidence levels

Pinning a legal right bit in the repeated-block M8 example adds E13 to the
dual and changes its multiplier to UT2(F2) plus M2(F2), with a nonzero
square-zero radical. Thus the inherited semisimple certificate is not closed
under these conditions. This refutes that self-reduction argument, not all
sampling methods or conditioned-count hardness. The separate old diamond
transfer counts ordered crossing pairs with a common target carrier; it
does not cover arbitrary crossings or replace the distinct-carrier theorem.

The final 72-input E6 fixture, its all-output section and its generic sampler
share one acquired certificate in the source integration record. At c=8,
the generic 256-character fallback is already feasible; this is an admission
and correctness example, not E6 speed evidence. The high-c formula run is
explicitly formula-only, not a raw-circuit acquisition. The retained audit
target-shift error was in the harness; production correctly declined it.

The ordinary comparison uses a DIFFERENT 72-input, 24676-gate crossing
fixture with full-equivalence unique-extension Tseitin encoding. Source
records show d4 and SharpSAT-TD count timeouts at 120 seconds, and a separate
d4 compilation timeout with an empty invalid artifact. Sampling was not
reached; there is no measured sampling ratio, ordinary SAT witness timing,
broad portfolio result or independent large-count validation from those
timeouts. New crossing pipeline time 23.1144 seconds and E6 pipeline time
19.6630 seconds must not be compared as matched fixtures. The specified
source executions, compiler pins, controls and limits remain visible.

No theorem here solves unrestricted Boolean counting. No novelty, physical
measurement, working device, practical advantage or mission achievement is
inferred. Internally verified mathematics is accepted without adding an
external-review prerequisite; genuine recognition, cost, conditioning and
implementation qualifications remain.
